author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಹಣವು ಇದ್ದೊಡೆಯೇನು ಅಧಿಕಾರವಿರಲೇನು
ಗುಣಹೀನನಾದೊಡನೆ ಜೀವನವೆ ವ್ಯರ್ಥ
ಕುಣಿಯುತಿರೆ ಹಣ ಸತ್ತೆ ಅವಗುಣದ ಮದವೆಂದು
ಹಣಿವುದಕೆ ಬೇಕರಿವು ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: What if you have wealth? What if you have power?
Once you are empty of virtue, life itself is wasted;
when money and might start dancing, know it is the drunkenness of vice —
and to strike it down, you need awareness, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Wealth and power mean little without good character; without it, life is wasted. When money and authority go to your head, that is vice showing itself, and only awareness can bring it down.
